root_cause: The bounded 3-topic external internet scanner indexed topics by floor(epoch/20min)*3 modulo active topic count. For 44 active topics, a daily trigger at a fixed time advances by 216 mod 44=40, visiting only 33 topics even after arbitrarily many days.
fix: Reuse the canonical bg-externe-signalen scheduler and provider auth. Advance the 3-topic cursor by UTC epoch day plus intra-day 20-minute slot, covering a static 44-topic registry within 15 daily runs, no extra searches per run. Store selection contract and horizon in existing source-observation lineage.
prevention_rule: Any bounded external market/topic sampler must prove fair eventual coverage for a constant scheduled daily hour and stable same-slot retries; never promote undiscovered or undated SERP data into customer or paid-order proof.
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required/CodeQL, protected merge, Supabase edge function deployment readback, and next actual source run evidence. No live claim from GitHub merge alone; no fabricated date, customer interest or paid revenue.
